editorial.blurb: Avec captures the warmth of Mediterranean dining through beautifully executed small plates designed for sharing, with a cozy, minimalist space that feels both intimate and lively.
editorial.insiderTip: Come with a group to share tapas-style plates family-style—the menu and pricing are optimized for this, and skip the Restaurant Week menu if possible to explore the full seasonal offerings like chorizo-stuffed dates and pork shoulder specials.
